lines.text: Many learners say: He drives a bike to school.
Better: He rides a bike to school.
We drive cars and trucks. We ride bikes and horses.
Rides! He rides a bike to school.

data.wrong: He drives a bike to school.
data.right: He rides a bike to school.
data.why: We drive cars and trucks. We ride bikes and horses.
